newsitem.title: UK: Nanny business booming in Britain - report.
newsitem.headline: Nanny business booming in Britain - report.

text.p: The nanny business is booming in Britain and there are more than 100,000 nannies working in British families now -- four times as many as 10 years ago.

A Mintel market intelligence report, cited by the Sunday Times, said Britons spend 4.3 billion pounds ($7.29 billion) a year on domestic help, making hiring nannies one of the fastest-growing areas of consumer spending.
